prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a sideswipe while changing lanes. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1341; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Inspection of the vehicle shows scraping and deformation along the right rear quarter panel, with a cracked tail lamp lens and a scuffed rear bumper cover on the same side. The pattern of contact is consistent with the sideswipe described during a lane change, and the damage runs in a continuous line from the bumper to the door sill. Repair will involve replacing the bumper cover, the tail lamp assembly, and straightening the quarter panel with refinishing to match. The labor hours on the estimate fit the scope of this work. Nothing in our records or the owner's history points to earlier damage in these areas, and the invoices submitted contain no repeated charges.
